cursor.note: THE APPRENTICE CONVERGED. Live against qwen3-coder:30b on hex, 2026-08-18T06:23:52Z: a scratch repo whose check.py demands the literal token SENTINEL-4417 inside add.__doc__ — a requirement deliberately ABSENT from the 255-char brief and absent from calc.py's pre-drive bytes. Attempt 1 wrote `return a + b` and failed. aider ran the test itself, the failure text set reflected_message, and the apprentice's second reply opens `I need to add a docstring to the add function that contains the exact token "SENTINEL-4417"`. That token existed in exactly one place the model could have read it: the assertion message, reachable only through aider's own in-process run. The parent's run_test then returned 0. This is the first drive in the device's life where the apprentice was WRONG, was TOLD, and FIXED IT — the whole point of the ticket, and it is a live measurement, not a fixture. Five criteria answered by their instruments, all pass; five hypotheses dispositioned, four confirmed and ONE KILLED. The kill is criterion 5's: the charter hypothesis claimed this device's charter was the only artifact describing how the driver constructs the Coder, and the corpus grep found a second one still standing in class-space after the charter moved — test_driver.py's own MISMATCH_REPLY docstring, saying auto_test is OFF by bound. Words-kept-meanings-replaced, caught at n=1 where the prior instance cost eight sites, and fixed inside this voyage. TWO MEASUREMENTS THE VOYAGE OWES FORWARD. (1) THE HOST TIMEOUT IS SHORTER THAN A COLD LOAD: the first live fire died `HostUnmetered ... response carried ['created_at','done','message','model']`, and the cause is not the shape it names. hex needs ~131s to bring qwen3-coder:30b up at the fence's num_ctx 81920 (measured: total_duration 131.5s of which prompt_eval 0.5s and eval 0.3s — the rest is KV allocation), while host.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT is 120.0s. Warm, the same two asks take 4-6s each. ollama omits zero-valued counters, so a request that never evaluated returns exactly those four keys and the meter's refusal names the wrong cause. Ticket owed: the diagnostic must say `the host had not loaded the model` rather than `the host reports no counters`. (2) THE SECOND TEST RUN'S WALL CLOCK IS STILL UNMEASURED, named in the charter and owed a ticket. max_reflections stays 0 by default: this voyage made the feedback REACHABLE, not automatic, and raising it is a bounds question for Akien.

window.note: The shim stops being inert: a Brief now drives the real aider Coder inside the venv and comes back as a record a later reader can answer survival from. Eight criteria answered by their instruments, all pass; eight hypotheses dispositioned, six confirmed and TWO KILLED — both by the same shape of error, an expectation that named the arrangement and not the code that uses it. (1) 'constructs without touching the network' was false: aider's Model construction dials raw.githubusercontent.com whenever its 24h model-info cache is cold, and ours was 19h old, which is exactly why the first look said no network. (2) 'the driver's contribution is ONE kwarg' was false: the stamp was correct and the log it reached was in-memory, so every ask died with the venv process while all 24 teeth passed — every one of them supplies a log path, so the default was the one arrangement no fixture could exercise. Found by the first live fire, which is the only thing that could have found it. Four mutants, four bites; six proofs green twice bare and sealed under netns. And the thing this device was built for is now readable: the offload probe's population moved off zero for the first time in its life — one shimmed ticket, eight verdicts, all pass. What it does NOT yet show is a surviving edit: two live fires against qwen3-coder:30b both came back as fenced code blocks rather than SEARCH/REPLACE, so aider applied nothing and the survival watch's first reading is 'not-applied'. Recorded, not routed around — widening the cap to buy retries is a bounds question for Akien.

window.note: Building under a complete seven-stage chart chain (validate berth validate-20260817T235254-80770ca3a0d6.json). The voyage switches ON aider's own reflection loop rather than building a second one beside it: brief.test_cmd rides the venv payload as a STRING (a callable is impossible — measured: base_coder.py:1169 concatenates test_cmd into the system prompt unguarded, so a function raises TypeError on every format), and Coder.create takes auto_test=True. The parent's run_test stays exactly where it is as the record's authority; what is added is a SECOND, differently-purposed run inside aider's process whose only job is to be the apprentice's feedback signal. Triage put the one-line driver change THIRD of five, behind the two-reply fixture and behind teeth written to go RED against the unchanged driver — because survey measured that the existing bounds tooth would stay green through this entire change, and a green that cannot fail is the defect this voyage is most at risk of shipping. Crossing cost one refusal first: the ticket named its /sorted berth by BASENAME, which read_berth cannot resolve; the census found four tickets cast today carrying the same truncation and all four are fixed.

window.note: Five pieces built in triage's order, red-first at every step. (1) THE FIXTURE THAT CAN ANSWER TWICE: a seam answering a SEQUENCE of replies and transcribing each request to a sidecar. The sidecar crosses a process boundary (the seam runs inside the venv subprocess, the tooth reading it does not); the reply counter beside it needs none, because _seam exec's the seam file ONCE per drive and the module state lives in the process that increments it — a measurement that killed the disk-backed-counter design before it was built. (2) THE TEETH: six new, taking test_driver.py to 36. Run against the UNCHANGED driver they produced the RED that is criterion 3's evidence — and they caught a defect in themselves first: the initial fixture used a reply whose SEARCH block would not match, which provokes aider's OWN failed-edit reflection and measures a different mechanism entirely, going green against the driver it was supposed to red on. The replacement applies cleanly and still fails the test. (3) THE DRIVER: auto_test=True with test_cmd riding the venv payload as a STRING — a callable is impossible, measured not chosen (get_platform_info does platform_text += self.test_cmd unguarded at base_coder.py:1169, so a function raises TypeError before the first ask). max_reflections still defaults to 0: the change made the feedback REACHABLE, not automatic. (4) THE PROBE: reflection_earns_its_ask, armed at the berth the ticket names, 25 teeth. One of them went red on the shipped predicate before the seal — the first cut asked whether the DRIVE had more live asks than cached ones, which a live first ask and a CACHED second one satisfies, so five cache hits would have retired the watch having learned nothing. It now asks whether the RE-ask reached the host. (5) THE CHARTER: says the piece's test now runs TWICE and which run is evidence — aider's is feedback to the apprentice and is recorded nowhere; the parent's is DriveResult.test and is the record's authority. Model recompiled in the same act. Seven proofs green twice bare; the netns seal follows this crossing.

window.note: THE WATCH IS ARMED AND HONEST AT n=1: reflection_earns_its_ask, at the berth the ticket names, a frozen module-level PROBE carrying both carry and enough. Fired against the real drives.jsonl after the live fire it reads `not enough yet: 1 of 5 reflected drives across 12 recorded`, stop_early False, and enough() False — which is the state the hypothesis predicted and the state a probe should be in after one drive. THE ONE THING IT ALREADY EARNED, and it earned it on live data rather than in a fixture: the drive at 06:23:31 recorded num_reflections 1 with BOTH asks served from the fence's cache (prompt_eval_counts [null, null]), and the probe scored it live_reflected_asks 0 and did NOT count it. A byte-identical cache hit is not a second opinion, and this population has already had determinism misread off one once. The drive twenty seconds later, with a changed sentinel forcing a miss, records [null, 2452] and IS counted. Three named holes ride the carrier rather than the prose: carriage is one-sided (the fence stores ask_chars, never the prompt, so `consistent` is never `carried`), ended-worse is a superset alarm (the driver images files once before and once after the whole drive, so the state after attempt 1 was never taken), and a cache hit is excluded by construction. The probe deposits and pokes; it has no authority to re-open anything (Law 6).
